summary: Web standalone SPA. Single-page state-driven routing (React useState in index.html App). 11 routes: home/menu/orders/loyalty/about/checkout/payment/confirm/track + 5 modals/drawers. Data SSOT via window.LC.menu (data/menu.js) mirroring central system. Wizard 4 templates + custom composer. Funnel 4-step state machine OK. Cart state in React only (no localStorage by design per README) — mock data, will wireup to Sanctum later. 76/76 existing E2E spec PASS on baseline cycle 1.

findings_p2.title: Cart state not persisted across page reload (designed, but no inline doc)
findings_p2.evidence: index.html line 80: const [cart, setCart] = useState([{...W_ITEMS[0], qty: 1}]); — React state only. README says wireup is future task. Refresh page = lose cart. Acceptable for standalone preview but worth docstring.
findings_p2.recommendation: Add inline comment: '[DESIGN] Cart is ephemeral React state; persistence via Sanctum cookie + backend is V1.1 wireup'. Defer real heal to backend integration task.

findings_p2.title: Checkout back button drops cart to menu route (cart preserved in App state, OK)
findings_p2.evidence: funnel.jsx CheckoutPage onBack={()=>{ setRoute('menu'); setCartOpen(true); }} — opens cart drawer on menu. cart array stays in App.
findings_p2.recommendation: Already correct, just document the loop home→menu→cart→checkout→back→menu+cart_open as state machine spec.

verdict: ARCH OK. Architecture sound, state machine clean, routing trivially correct. No P0/P1 from structural perspective.
